svg.title: Puzzle Forge Jigsaw connector grammar atlas
svg.desc: High-fidelity specimens generated from the eight current connector grammars. Each grammar shows a representative tab, matching blank, and left, centered, and right-biased seeded variants.
svg.text: Each row is a distinct structural production—not a parameter preset of one universal connector.
TAB / BLANK share a seed. LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT expose legal seeded placement and, for repeat grammars, may also expose structural count variation.

g.text: One ordinary smooth crown; no reversal or secondary event.
Narrow shaft opens into one overhanging chamber.
Several lateral crowns separated by explicit saddles.
Broad sweep doubles back into a deep one-sided bite.
One lobe crosses the baseline into an opposed lobe.
Orthogonal staircase / skyline with repeated levels.
Repeated diagonal turns between high and low levels.
Two outward chambers separated by a narrow waist.
